title: Multiband Parametric EQ
text: Multiband parametric equalizer, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough; {EQ order} sets the order of individual equalizer bands, {Number of bands} sets the number of equalizer bands, {Specify frequencies from input port}, {Frequencies (Hz)} sets the center frequencies of equalizer, {Specify peak gains from input port}, {Peak Gains (dB)} sets the peak or dip filter gains, {Specify quality factors from input port}, {Quality factors}, {Inherit sample rate from input} sets the sample rate from input port, {Input sample rate (Hz)}, {Visualize filter response} sets the visualize magnitude response of equalizer, {Variable name}, {Overwrite variable if it already exists}, {Export filter to workspace}, {Add low-shelf filter}, {Specify low-shelf cutoff from input port} sets the low-shelf cutoff frequency from input port, {Low-shelf cutoff frequency (Hz)}, {Specify low-shelf slope from input port}, {Low-shelf filter slope} sets the low-shelf slope, {Specify low-shelf gain from input port}, {Low-shelf filter gain (dB)} sets the low-shelf gain, {Add high-shelf filter}, {Specify high-shelf cutoff from input port} sets the high-shelf cutoff frequency from input, {High-shelf cutoff frequency (Hz)} sets the high-shelf cutoff frequency 15e3, {Specify high-shelf slope from input port}, {High-shelf filter slope} sets the high-shelf slope, {Specify high-shelf gain from input port}, {High-shelf filter gain (dB)} sets the high-shelf gain, {Add lowpass filter}, {Specify lowpass cutoff from input port} sets the lowpass cutoff frequency from input port, {Lowpass cutoff frequency (Hz)} sets the lowpass cutoff frequency 18e3, {Specify lowpass slope from input port}, {Lowpass filter slope} sets the lowpass slope, {Add highpass filter}, {Specify highpass cutoff from input port} sets the highpass cutoff frequency from input port, {Highpass cutoff frequency (Hz)}, {Specify highpass slope from input port}, {Highpass filter slope} sets the highpass slope, {Oversample} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.
